rules.rule: Preserve all 141 sourcing cases, parameter rows, transaction/history chains, permissions and assertions while splitting only independent fixture groups; retain complete canonical PG.
rules.source: User-authorized CI PR2; Library dx-ci-regression-study.md v2 sections 8.3, P2 and 16; AGENTS.md sections 3-5; docs/governance/github-actions-usage-policy-v1.0.md PR2.
rules.initialization: Each group owns its full migrated schema, pools, mock storage, users, factory identities and mutable todo state. C05 and P13/P14 sequential chains remain intact. Contract refresh explicitly initializes the same real roles formerly supplied by a preceding digital fixture; role guards and all assertions remain. Shared cycleSnapshot moved into the fixture. Workers/timeouts and sequential managed cleanup unchanged.
rules.dateAndPermission: All fixed synthetic business dates, current/history permissions, rejection, rollback, concurrent and idempotency assertions retained; 140 expanded case bodies unchanged, one adds fixture setup only. No production data or privileges changed.
rules.expectation: Source-derived and baseline-report-checked identities partition as 91+50. Reject missing, duplicate, skipped, foreign or misplaced identities. Complete PG 415 cases in 24 files, exact cleanup, no scope reductions.

rules.rule: Only the exact offline deployment fixture may be excluded for proven independent existing application-source/prose modifications; deployment inputs and all unknown/change-status paths keep the complete original suite.
rules.source: User-authorized PR2 deployment boundary review; dx-ci-regression-study.md sections 6 and 16; AGENTS.md exact scope and failure requirements; docs/governance/github-actions-usage-policy-v1.0.md PR2.
rules.initialization: Freeze NUL-separated exact Git change statuses and paths with base/head, required reason and complete file plan; each lane recomputes and validates the shared bundle before execution, native file results must match. Only M application TS/TSX/CSS and Markdown can omit the named wrapper; all other paths/statuses and parse failures run all 22 Python cases. Local npm test stays complete.
rules.dateAndPermission: No business, deployment/rollback, low-privilege, migration/history or PG-version assertions removed. Existing 11 conditional nonDB skips stay disclosed. No deployment, production access or change to repository permissions.
rules.expectation: Unknown/add/delete/rename/type/config/fixture/script/workflow/lock changes remain mandatory; selector is itself high risk. Real Vitest fixture validates single-file omission and fallback; current governance candidate executes all 22 offline cases. Budget negative controls retain exact limits and now copy the new read dependency.

rules.rule: Recognize complete initialization JSON records before native Vitest text summaries without treating the mixed command log as a single JSON test report.
rules.source: Actual PR2 request-final preview rejected the unchanged successful PG log before any final ref was created; AGENTS.md section 4 requires real reports and no bypass.
rules.initialization: Parse a whole valid JSON document as a report; otherwise permit only a complete first-line JSON metadata object without report fields before evaluating the original text summaries. All pinned log/report hashes, totals, case identities, failure checks and pre-POST rejection remain.
rules.dateAndPermission: No repository permissions, approvals, production inputs or test assertion thresholds change. The failed preview created no Full request. Original raw logs remain unmodified.
rules.expectation: Mixed initialization JSON plus text succeeds only with exact pinned native results. Unpinned or mismatched totals, failed/truncated JSON test reports and failed text suites all reject with zero POST writes. Actual original PG log/report preview is rechecked through the same original controller without apply.
